Claudia: quick sync postmortem follow-up for the KV-cache OOMs. need owners + short ETAs for remediation tasks. keep replies short.

Claudia: tasks: 1) lightweight jemalloc + slab profiling on canary, 2) compaction tuning + scheduled job, 3) soft memory limiter to avoid hard OOM, 4) nightly regression checks, 5) investigate recurring Wed/Sat spikes.

Ravi: taking 1. will enable periodic heap snapshots + slab-stats on canary for 72h. ETA Thu EOD. will add safe capture script to avoid CPU bursts.

Marisol: taking 2. plan: lower max_cache_retention -> 4h on canary, enable background_compact, add cron compaction Sat 03:30 UTC with CPU guard. ETA 9 days.

sre-oncall: taking 3 (PoC). soft limiter that returns 429 when mem% > 85%. ETA 3 days. will prototype as middleware.

Jon: taking 4. nightly harness: worst-case prompts + mem profiler, alert if 95p > baseline + 15%. ETA 5 days for baseline.

InfraBot: note: backup snapshots correlate with spike windows (last 6 weeks): Wed ~03:00 UTC and Sat ~03:00 UTC.

Claudia: assigning 5 to Ravi + Marisol to correlate slab dumps with backup times. add any config diffs as small PRs. next check-in Tue sync 09:30 PT.

Ravi: upload link once captures complete -> s3://redwood-incidents/1799751111/

Marisol: will post compaction YAML and circuit-breaker logic in the PR.

Claudia: ack all. I'll update the incident board with owners and due-dates. keep notes in the ticket; ping here only for blockers. :white_check_mark:
